candidates.snippet: Sarkodie's sold out Rapperholic Concert had over 55,000 attendees at Ghana's largest stadium, Baba Yara Stadium in Kumasi.

Wizkid remains the most streamed African Artist on Spotify.

He is the first African Artist to surpass 12 billion total streams on the platform.

Adekunle Gold attends back to back Ballon D’or ceremonies in 2025 and 2026 as a UEFA VVIP guest.

Last night, he wore a 1 of 25 special edition USD $500,000 Vanguart Orb Rose Flying Tourbillon luxury watch.
